applies_why: The judge resolves D1 vs C3 by asking whether a cited verse's own words state the contrary and treats the passive verb as stating no verdict, rather than weighing chain against chain by footing.
quote: neither text's own words state the other reading's contrary.
rule_words: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: never verse by verse / by footing: one reading permits deciding from whether a single verse's own words state the contrary, the other requires chain-against-chain weighing by footing.
why: The judge made the absence of a single verse stating the contrary decisive, which is the retired stating-verse test rather than chain-against-chain footing.
